SELECT p.ID, AVG(l.UA) AS average_uric_acid, AVG(l.HCT) AS average_hematocrit
FROM Patient AS p
LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS ra_lab
    WHERE ra_lab.ID = p.ID AND ra_lab.RA = '-'
)
GROUP BY p.ID
ORDER BY CASE WHEN AVG(l.HCT) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, AVG(l.HCT) DESC
LIMIT 10;
